info.title: fx 0.9.0 · Your repositories as one space: for people, for CI and for agents.
info.description: fx, the tool of Fuxion's spaces: what they mount, the shared build of .NET (with Fuxion.Tool.Sdk), the instructions for the coding agents and the versions, from the configuration in _fx/. A native executable for each platform.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: fx ui · the space in full screen (in a terminal; Ctrl+Q closes it)

commands.name: adopt
commands.description: Adopts documents: Markdown without a sidecar gets it where it is (the bootstrap ones by default); with --manifest, the batches of the adoption manifests, at once.

options.name: --root
options.description: Folder to act on (the current one by default).

options.name: --space
options.description: Act on the nearest space that mounts others, itself included, from anywhere inside it.

options.name: --output
options.description: human (by default); json, a document; ndjson, events and then the document. Stable, always in English.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: More detail, on stderr.

options.name: --plain
options.description: No colors or borders.

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: No questions and no live progress, whatever the terminal (for scripts and CI).

options.name: --lang
options.description: Language of the messages: en or es (by default, FX_LANG or the system's).

commands.name: check
commands.description: Checks the documents of the catalog, or the ones given: their sidecars, names, places, titles, relations, links and integrity.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Adds an entry at the end of a register.

commands.name: close
commands.description: Closes an entry of a register, now.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the entries of a register.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Changes an entry of a register: its title, status, summary, tags, fields and relations.

commands.name: finalize
commands.description: Finalizes documents: their integrity again and updatedAt now, for those that changed.

commands.name: key
commands.description: The next key of a register that uses them, reserved by its provider (repo: the next of the register, in every branch; git: an atomic reservation on the remote); with --confirm, its provisional keys reserved now.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the documents of the catalog, with filters.

commands.name: move
commands.description: Moves a stable document to another folder of the catalog, with its annexes, and rewrites the links to them.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Creates a document: its Markdown with its title and its sidecar, in the place of its type.

commands.name: relate
commands.description: Adds a relation from a document to another (or takes it out); supersedes also replaces the target.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: The types of the documentation standard; with a type, its JSON Schema.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Shows a document: its metadata, its relations and the inverse ones.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Changes the status of a document, if its type allows it, and finalizes it.

commands.description: Checks the documents of the catalog, or the ones given: their sidecars, names, places, titles, relations, links and integrity.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Adds an entry at the end of a register.

commands.name: close
commands.description: Closes an entry of a register, now.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the entries of a register.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Changes an entry of a register: its title, status, summary, tags, fields and relations.

commands.name: finalize
commands.description: Finalizes documents: their integrity again and updatedAt now, for those that changed.

commands.name: key
commands.description: The next key of a register that uses them, reserved by its provider (repo: the next of the register, in every branch; git: an atomic reservation on the remote); with --confirm, its provisional keys reserved now.

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the documents of the catalog, with filters.

commands.name: move
commands.description: Moves a stable document to another folder of the catalog, with its annexes, and rewrites the links to them.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Creates a document: its Markdown with its title and its sidecar, in the place of its type.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: The types of the documentation standard; with a type, its JSON Schema.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Shows a document: its metadata, its relations and the inverse ones.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Changes the status of a document, if its type allows it, and finalizes it.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: The JSON Schema of an output of fx; without an id, the list of them.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --root
options.description: Folder to act on (the current one by default).

options.name: --space
options.description: Act on the nearest space that mounts others, itself included, from anywhere inside it.

options.name: --output
options.description: human (by default); json, a document; ndjson, events and then the document. Stable, always in English. [default: human]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: More detail, on stderr.

options.name: --plain
options.description: No colors or borders.

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: No questions and no live progress, whatever the terminal (for scripts and CI).

options.name: --lang
options.description: Language of the messages: en or es (by default, FX_LANG or the system's).
